_comment: A Prince of Persia project needs no file of its own: the game is the original 1.0 data, which the project brings as firmware (the core's firmware list). A custom level set is the one file a project may add.

slots.title: Custom levels
slots.help: A LEVELS.DAT of a custom level set (from a level editor or a mod), played in place of the original levels; the rest of the game is still the original 1.0 data. Leave it empty for the original game.
